title: Convert KB to MB
about: Convert kilobytes to megabytes using the standard binary file-size relationship. Enter a value in KB and BROBEX calculates its equivalent in MB immediately, with adjustable decimal precision and a copy control.
steps: Enter a non-negative value in kilobytes.
Choose the number of decimal places if needed.
Copy the result or reset the converter.
capabilities: Instant local calculation using 1,024 KB = 1 MB. This utility converts a numerical file-size value only; it does not upload, resize or alter a file.
benefits: Quickly translate file-size values between MB and KB when checking upload requirements, image dimensions or document limits.
limitations: This tool converts values only and does not change a file. It uses the binary convention of 1 MB = 1,024 KB; some services display decimal units.

faqs.question: How do I convert KB to MB?
faqs.answer: Divide the KB value by 1,024 to get MB using the binary convention.

faqs.question: Does this tool change my file?
faqs.answer: No. It converts the number you enter and does not modify a file.
